description: Real ArduPilot flights from discuss.ardupilot.org whose cause was stated by a developer or an experienced helper who analysed the log. Logs are not redistributed: fetch each from source_url and check sha256.

entries.title: Desired Pitch ignored - crashing at launch
entries.rationale: The V-tail MIXING_GAIN was left at 0.5, which gave too little elevator travel to climb after launch; the OP raised it to 0.85 and that fixed the problem.

entries.title: No tracking data available for FFT Notch and Throttle Notch
entries.rationale: Twisted or misaligned motor mounts on a flexible frame gave a yaw bias that kept two motors at minimum and caused low-frequency noise; the OP agreed the arm fixings were poor.

entries.title: Motors stop - 10 minutes into second hover test flight - copter falls 5' to the ground
entries.rationale: The 4-in-1 ESC hit about 130 C in its enclosure and shut down thermally, so current and RPM went to zero mid-hover; oscillating outputs added heat, and the OP agreed.

entries.title: Arduplane 4.6.2 on TBS MOJITO : upside down flight after takeoff
entries.rationale: The flying wing ran far faster than its configured SCALING_SPEED/AIRSPEED_MAX and WP_RADIUS allowed, which cut surface authority and asked for impossible bank angles; poor EKF, compass and GPS health made it worse (the second flight crashed).

entries.title: EKF in-flight reset and bad initialization during compass-less operation
entries.rationale: An in-flight EKF3 yaw reset during compass-less flight with a wrong yaw source (EK3_SRC1_YAW should be GPS) produced a roughly 50 degree roll estimate jump that tilted the copter past 60 degrees.

entries.title: Random Large Compass Variance
entries.rationale: Being tethered to a line put an unexpected external force on the vehicle, so error built up in the EKF/compass learning (EK3_MAG_CAL=3) until compass variance and toilet-bowling appeared.

entries.title: Find the cause of robocraft crash
entries.rationale: The pilot cancelled the battery failsafe RTL and kept flying until the 12S battery collapsed and the copter fell; the battery thresholds for 12S were also set wrong.

entries.title: After EKF failsafe, the drone just fell from 80 m
entries.rationale: GPS was the EKF altitude source and a sudden GPS glitch (satellite count collapsing) corrupted the height estimate, so during the EKF-failsafe land the copter descended hard and crashed; the OP accepted this and moved back to baro.

entries.title: Flaps deploying on rc failsafe Arduplane 4.6.3
entries.rationale: The flaps deployed on RC failsafe because RC7 was reversed instead of SERVO7; the OP fixed the reversal and the problem went away.

entries.title: Driving Harmonic Notches using Dynamic FFT Method
entries.rationale: The RC outputs show a mechanical yaw bias and large oscillations on top of a messy, partly default parameter set, so the craft was not ready for notch setup; the OP asked how to fix the yaw bias.

entries.title: Can't get my flying wing to take off
entries.rationale: The hand launch was thrown far too steeply (pitch above 75 degrees at low speed), so the wing could not accelerate and stalled and rolled left into the ground; the OP accepted this.

entries.title: Automatic landing failure to establish flare resulted hard touch down
entries.rationale: The flare started too low for the vehicle's pitch response, so the sink rate could not be arrested before touchdown; raising LAND_FLARE_ALT fixed it (the first log also had the known TECS flare-demand issue that was patched later).

entries.title: Unhealthy GPS in Arducopter even with good NSat and HDOP
entries.rationale: A GNSS receiver tracking too many constellations dropped below a 5 Hz update rate, which caused the 'Unhealthy GPS' errors and Loiter/Auto drift; the fix is to limit GNSS_MODE.

entries.title: ArduPlane 4.6.3 TAKEOFF mode: climbs ~8 m then nose-down and crash (AtomRC Swordfish V-tail)
entries.rationale: SCALING_SPEED and the airspeed parameters were far below the plane's real takeoff speed, so the elevator authority was scaled down and the plane nosed over; the OP raised SCALING_SPEED, adjusted takeoff settings and then launched successfully.

entries.title: Arducopter Auto Armed
entries.rationale: The log shows the copter was armed and told to take off over MAVLink in GUIDED by the GCS operator, not by the autopilot itself, and it then flipped on the ground (disarm reason: crash).

entries.title: What's this peak about in my FFT plot?
entries.rationale: The 150 Hz peak is just a prop/frame harmonic, and almost no noise gets past the existing gyro low-pass filter, so no fix is needed; the OP agreed.

entries.title: The quad, in all flight modes, rolls to the left
entries.rationale: The roll stick centre (about 1385 us) did not match RC1_TRIM (1495), so the quad always saw a left-roll input; recalibrating the radio fixed it.

entries.title: TAKEOFF mode : after few seconds pitch down and crash
entries.rationale: The wing was thrown far too nose-high and launched with arming checks off and no GPS fix, so it stalled in TAKEOFF with no useful speed data; the OP confirmed there were zero satellites at launch.

entries.title: Motor overheating with default PIDs
entries.rationale: The quad is underpowered/overweight for its clone motors (hover thrust about 0.35) and its vertical acceleration gains are too high, which explains the hot motors; the OP accepted this and changed motors.

entries.title: Unusual Current Reports
entries.rationale: A power short damaged the current sensor in the power module, so the logged current was nonsense and the throttle-gain compensation went wrong; swapping in a known-good sensor showed the old one was bad.

entries.title: New beta fly away
entries.rationale: Ground mag anomalies left the EKF yaw far from the DCM yaw, which drove the PosHold flyaway; the final impact came from the pilot losing orientation in Stabilize.

entries.title: Loiter Mode: Drone Drifts Aggressively After Releasing Sticks to Neutral — Regression in 4.8.0dev (Works Fine on 4.6)
entries.rationale: In the 4.8-dev log, LOIT_OPTIONS=1 turned on Loiter coordinated turns, which caused the drift after the sticks were centred; setting it to 0 fixed it (144203_0 is the normal 4.6 reference flight).

entries.title: Sudden mid-flight power cut (no failsafe)
entries.rationale: The overweight EDF quad ran its outputs near saturation (repeated thrust-loss errors), and the 4-in-1 ESC most likely overheated or browned out and cut all motors together; the OP agreed.

entries.title: Done flipped after switching from stabalize to ALT_HOLD
entries.rationale: Logging stops abruptly in the air, which points to a sudden loss of power to the autopilot rather than tuning, GPS or a mode-change problem.

entries.title: Firmware update and autotune
entries.rationale: Logging ended at about 35 m with Vcc only about 4.4 V, a flight-controller brownout; the OP then found loose power-module wiring (and ESC BECs feeding the servo rail).

entries.title: 10inch copter tuning. Throttle notch
entries.rationale: Apart from too many harmonic-notch options enabled, the log shows nothing wrong, and a 10% hover throttle is normal for this build.

entries.title: Quad: roll & pitch fine, but persistent uncontrolled yaw spin (yaw appears inverted)
entries.rationale: The frame was built props-out (mirrored motor rotation), so FRAME_TYPE did not match and the yaw control was inverted; setting FRAME_TYPE=18 (BF-reversed X) stopped the yaw spin.

entries.title: Quad loosing thrust on one channel only
entries.rationale: The motor, ESC or prop on output 11 failed in hover and caused the crash; the dynamic notch was also badly misconfigured.

entries.title: Quadcopter flies in desired path but changes heading abruptly during AUTO mission
entries.rationale: A yaw stick/trim offset beyond the RC4 deadzone (trim 1529 with the stick at about 1509) gave a constant yaw input, so the nose pointed away from the track during Auto legs.

entries.title: ArduPilot 5-Inch Drone Using Optical Flow and Rangefinder for Indoor Position Hold – Altitude Oscillations
entries.rationale: The indoor altitude swings come from the EKF height estimate drifting away from the rangefinder (vibration-affected accelerometer and too little rangefinder weighting), not from the altitude controller.

entries.title: Pitch peaks in AUTO turns
entries.rationale: The commanded pitch/roll oscillations in AUTO come from the horizontal velocity PID loop, and relaxed PSC_NE gains plus lower WP_ACC/WP_JERK reduce them; the attitude tuning itself is fine.

entries.title: CTUN.Alt graph going up while CTUN.CRt is negative
entries.rationale: A RemoteID module was passing GPS data to the FC with about 1 s of delay, so the altitude estimate lagged and caused the vertical oscillation; replacing it with a normal GPS fixed it.

entries.title: Quad slowly drifts left and continuously yaws left in Loiter mode
entries.rationale: Roll and yaw RC inputs sat outside TRIM plus or minus the deadzone, so Loiter saw constant stick input and drifted and yawed; recalibrating the radio stopped the drift, and the remaining yaw has the same cause.

entries.title: ArduCopter 4.7.1 – Barometer/EKF altitude corruption after hard descent causes 0–100% throttle commands in AltHold/Loiter
entries.rationale: Duct airflow on this cinewhoop gave large thrust-dependent barometer errors that corrupted the EKF height and tripped vibration compensation, which then produced 0/100% throttle; the fixes are the 4.7 baro thrust-scale parameter and a later code fix.

entries.title: ArduCopter 4.7.1 – Barometer/EKF altitude corruption after hard descent causes 0–100% throttle commands in AltHold/Loiter
entries.rationale: Duct airflow on this cinewhoop gave large thrust-dependent barometer errors that corrupted the EKF height and tripped vibration compensation, which then produced 0/100% throttle; the fixes are the 4.7 baro thrust-scale parameter and a later code fix.

entries.title: Oscillations and crash
entries.rationale: The 50 kg copter was barely tuned (default acceleration limits and filters for a small quad), so it overcorrected and went into a self-excited roll oscillation that crashed it.

entries.title: EKF3 vertical velocity/position runaway with BARO + no VELZ, while RangeFinder contains the position error
entries.rationale: An accelerometer offset with motors running, together with ground-effect/touchdown logic latching and no vertical velocity source, made the EKF height run away on the baro source; the OP confirmed that andyp1per's EKF PRs fixed it.

entries.title: Drone took off by itself
entries.rationale: The transmitter was still on when it was put away face down, the sticks re-armed the copter, and the radio failsafe RTL then lifted it off; the OP agreed.

entries.title: Slight shake of drone
entries.rationale: A frame resonance from a flexible frame and wobbly parts, plus too much filtering and odd yaw filter/PID settings, causes the in-flight shaking; stiffening the frame is the main fix and the OP is doing that.

entries.title: Octa_H_Plane strange throttle response
entries.rationale: The odd throttle response in this props-off bench log is expected open-loop behaviour, not a fault; the separate real problem (motor 5 not spinning in the motor test) was a bad ESC, which the OP replaced.
